chunks: And one of his words (peace be upon him) to some of his companions, after he had asked him: 'How did your people deprive you of this position while you are more deserving of it?' Then he said:
ai.seo_question: How did Quraysh deprive Imam Ali of the Caliphate?
ai.summary: This narration from Nahj al-Balagha records a companion asking Imam Ali (peace be upon him) how his tribe, Quraysh, managed to deprive him of the Caliphate despite his greater right to it. It highlights the historical event of the usurpation of leadership from the Ahl al-Bayt, reflecting the Shia scholarly emphasis on the divine designation (Nass) of the Imam versus the political expediency of the early community.
